newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan plans to sell state-owned National bank.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan plans to sell state-owned National bank.

text.p: The Pakistani government has plans to privatise the state-owned National Bank of Pakistan (NBP), Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz said on Friday.
However, he said in reply to a question in the lower house of parliament that no schedule for NBP's privatisation had yet been set.
"With a view to reducing administrative costs, necessary steps are under way to control wasteful expenditures through rationalisation of branches' network and over-staffing of the bank," he said.
Aziz said NBP had increased its "pre-tax profile" to six billion rupees ($148 million) at the end of 1996 from four billion rupees in 1995.
NBP was the only state-owned commercial bank before Pakistan nationalised all private banks in 1970s, two of whom have been privatised again in recent years.
